name: Chunbo Co., Ltd.
summary: Chunbo Co., Ltd. operates in the fine chemical materials industry in South Korea and internationally. The company supplies additives used in the manufacturing process of display application materials, such as LCD and OLED panels of TV or/and mobile phones, EMC resin raw materials. It also develops, produces, and supplies semiconductor application materials; and produces and supplies oxalic acid, and raw materials and intermediates for pharmaceutical companies. In addition, it offers secondary battery materials; and develops and produces specialty chemicals, such as additives used in tire, chemically reinforced glass material for display.
